messages:
elaine: Heads up — SF office: water main burst in the basement. Building ops just told us there's standing water in the lobby and elevator shafts. We're closing the SF office for the rest of today and likely tomorrow. DO NOT come in.

facility-team: Building maintenance: crew has isolated the supply line and started pumps. Elevator bank 1 is out, lobby carpet soaked. Estimated remediation 18–36 hrs; we'll update if that changes.

jess: If you were planning to come in today please cancel your desk reservation. We'll cancel reservations for tomorrow morning as a precaution and post an update by 8:00am PT.

sam: I have gear in rack A12 (on-prem). Is the data center affected? cc @miguel

miguel: Quick check from the remote console: racks show normal power and cooling, network peers up. No alerts from the colo sensors. Do NOT attempt physical access — we'll coordinate any required handoffs with facility + security.

facility-team: ```Building ops contact: 415-555-0101
Security: 415-555-0202
Onsite lead: jess@redwood.com```

nora: Thanks everyone. For folks who were traveling or need last-minute lodging because of this, People Ops will reimburse up to $200 for emergency stays. Submit expenses via Concur with the tag "SF-closure" and attach receipts.

alvaro: Security note: access cards may be temporarily disabled while crews work. If you have custody of hardware or keys, DM me so we can whitelist you or arrange escorted access.

jess: If you left personal items at your desk and need them retrieved, fill out this form: https://intranet.redwood.com/sf-item-retrieval (internal). Include a photo and preferred pickup window.

people-ops-bot: Reminder — SF teams: remote-first for today and tomorrow until we say otherwise. Please update your Slack status (e.g., :house:) and check calendar invites for virtual dial-in links.

doug: The Friday onsite demo is moved to virtual. We'll ship any hardware swag to people who RSVPed for onsite pickup next week.

elaine: Action items summary: 1) Do not come to the office. 2) Cancel/or reschedule travel if you're en route. 3) Fill the retrieval form for any on-site-only items. 4) Expense reimbursements: Concur tag 'SF-closure'. We'll post the next update here and in #sf-office-ops by 08:00am PT. If you have urgent needs, ping me or @jess. :white_check_mark:
